decisions.rationale: Six days in with no project, no invite, no tickets, and no reply to two outreach emails (email:dfadead8, email:e34b7261). Zero engagement signal makes unaided activation in the remaining 8 days unlikely, though the Team plan suggests real intent.

draft.subject: A hand with your first Wrenfield project
draft.body:
Hi Aisha,

No pressure on my earlier notes — I know setup often waits for a quieter week.

When you're ready, projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, and tasks live inside them, so creating the first one is the natural starting point. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and teammates can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through the first project with you and answer anything about getting the team in.

Best,
Chidi
